instruction: My last 3 amazon orders were for my roommates and me. The total cost is to be equally shared among all of us. Make venmo requests, one for each of my roommates, with a description note, "Amazon Purchases" and their share of the expense.
notes: Plan: read passwords, log into Amazon, list orders to get the ids of the 3 most recent ones, open each order to get its total, log into the phone app and search contacts with relationship="roommate" to get roommate emails (one call returns all roommates), log into Venmo, send one payment request per roommate with description "Amazon Purchases" and amount = (sum of the three order totals)/(roommates+1), then complete the task without an answer. Assumptions: the supervisor has 2 roommates (objects roommate-1/roommate-2); if the real count differs, add/remove roommate, email objects and adjust the arity of supervisor-complete-task accordingly. The per-roommate share is a runtime placeholder object; its availability is gated by the static (share-of o1 o2 o3 amt) fact plus order-cost-known for all three orders, which forces the three show_order lookups before any request. Roommate emails are static placeholder objects whose use is gated by (roommates-found), the effect of the single search_contacts call. Usernames: email for amazon/venmo, phone number for phone. supervisor-complete-task is parameterized over the two distinct roommates so its precondition mirrors the goal without referencing problem objects in the domain.

plan: (venmo-create-payment-request roommate-1-email share-per-roommate venmo-token note-amazon-purchases roommate-1 order-1 order-2 order-3)
(venmo-create-payment-request roommate-2-email share-per-roommate venmo-token note-amazon-purchases roommate-2 order-1 order-2 order-3)
(venmo-create-payment-request roommate-3-email share-per-roommate venmo-token note-amazon-purchases roommate-3 order-1 order-2 order-3)
